title: Type Level Length
description:
Implement `Length<T>` that extracts the length of a tuple as a numeric literal type, and `IsEmpty<T>` that checks whether a tuple is empty.

**Example:**
```ts
type A = Length<[1, 2, 3]>   // 3 (literal type)
type B = Length<[]>          // 0
type C = IsEmpty<[]>         // true
type D = IsEmpty<[1]>        // false
```
starter_code:
export type Length<T extends any[]> = // your type here
export type IsEmpty<T extends any[]> = // your type here
solution:
export type Length<T extends any[]> = T['length'];
export type IsEmpty<T extends any[]> = T extends [] ? true : false;
ai_context: Common mistake: trying to compute length with complex recursion when `T['length']` directly gives the numeric literal type. For `IsEmpty`, checking `T['length'] extends 0` also works but `T extends []` is more readable.
